label: Busy sky
description: Eight flights distributed across the 10 NM range.

label: One aircraft
description: A quiet board with one nearby flight.

label: Long / missing data
description: Long labels, missing values, and a flight at the range limit.

label: Compass points
description: Four flights due north, east, south, and west at increasing distances.

label: Crowded radar
description: Two aircraft on the same approach, one to the west, and one at the east range limit.

label: East traffic
description: Four aircraft on different bearings in the east sector.

label: Shared position
description: Four aircraft report the same radar position at different altitudes.

label: Empty sky
description: The feed succeeds but there are no nearby aircraft.

label: Waiting for clock
description: Wi-Fi is connected and the board is preparing its first flight request.

label: Receiver file expired
description: The receiver serves an old file and the board has no recent snapshot to show.

label: Stale radar
description: An expired receiver file leaves the last successful snapshot visible for a short time.

label: Feed quota reached
description: The feed returns a rate-limit response.

label: Invalid flight data
description: The feed response cannot be parsed.

label: Invalid data, retained radar
description: The board keeps its last good snapshot while the feed returns invalid data.
